Summary

CBCUS01C is a batch COBOL program within the CardDemo application that sequentially reads all records from an indexed customer data file (CUSTFILE) and displays each customer record to the system output. The program opens the customer file, iterates through every record until end-of-file is reached, prints each customer record, and then closes the file upon completion. This is a Main/Driver program with no external program calls other than an abend utility, and it operates independently without any CICS, DB2, IMS, or MQ interactions.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Display a message indicating the start of program execution for CBCUS01C 2: Open Customer File - Open the indexed customer data file in sequential access mode to prepare for reading all customer records 3: Sequential Customer Record Processing Loop - Continuously read and process customer records one by one until all records in the file have been read (end of file reached) 4: Read Next Customer Record - Read the next sequential customer record from the indexed customer file into the customer record structure 5: Display Customer Record - Print/display the customer record details to the output after each successful read 6: End of File Detection - Detect when there are no more customer records to read and set the end-of-file indicator to stop the processing loop 7: Read Error Detection - Identify and handle unexpected errors encountered while reading customer records, triggering error reporting and program termination 8: Close Customer File - Close the customer data file after all records have been read and processed 9: File Open Error Reporting - Display an error message with file status details when the customer file cannot be opened successfully, then terminate the program 10: File Read Error Reporting - Display an error message with file status details when an unexpected error occurs reading the customer file, then terminate the program 11: File Close Error Reporting - Display an error message with file status details when the customer file cannot be closed successfully, then terminate the program 12: Program Completion - Display a message indicating the end of program execution and return control to the calling environment

Program-Start-Display-L1: ```cobol DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBCUS01C'. ``` Customer-File-Open-L2: ```cobol OPEN INPUT CUSTFILE-FILE ``` Customer-File-Open-Success-Validation-L3: ```cobol IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CUSTFILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Customer-File-Open-Error-Reporting-L4: ```cobol DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CUSTFILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM ``` Sequential-Processing-Loop-L5: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CUSTOMER-RECORD END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM. ``` End-Of-File-Check-Before-Read-L6: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT ... END-IF END-PERFORM. ``` Read-Next-Customer-Record-L7: ```cobol READ CUSTFILE-FILE INTO CUSTOMER-RECORD. ``` Read-Status-Evaluation-L8: ```cobol IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT DISPLAY CUSTOMER-RECORD ELSE IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF END-IF ``` Display-Customer-Record-L9: ```cobol IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT DISPLAY CUSTOMER-RECORD ``` End-Of-File-Indicator-Setting-L10: ```cobol IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ... IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ``` Unexpected-Read-Error-Detection-L11: ```cobol ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF ... IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CUSTOMER FILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF END-IF ``` Read-Error-Reporting-L12: ```cobol DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CUSTOMER FILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM ``` Customer-File-Close-L13: ```cobol CLOSE CUSTFILE-FILE ``` Customer-File-Close-Success-Validation-L14: ```cobol IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT ELSE ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING CUSTOMER FILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Customer-File-Close-Error-Reporting-L15: ```cobol DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING CUSTOMER FILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM ``` Program-Completion-L16: ```cobol DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBCUS01C'. GOBACK. ```

6: End of File Detection

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Detect End-of-File Condition After Read Attempt-L_1: ```cobol READ CUSTFILE-FILE INTO CUSTOMER-RECORD. IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF END-IF ``` Set End-of-File Indicator to Stop Processing Loop-L_2: ```cobol IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ``` Exit Customer Record Processing Loop When End-of-File Indicator Is Set-L_3: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CUSTOMER-RECORD END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM ``` Continue Customer Record Processing When Record Successfully Retrieved-L_4: ```cobol IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT DISPLAY CUSTOMER-RECORD ```
